title: A tool returned needing repair is marked as needing repair through the outbox
given: Command handlers sharing one outbox over an in-memory store, with tools on loan: once without the event handler subscribed, once with it, and once with it failing.
when: Loans are returned needing repair with a note, needing repair with a blank note, and in good condition; after the failure, the fault is cleared and the relay runs again.
then: Without the handler, the return changes only the loan, and Tool returned is saved to the outbox with it and relayed with its fields; a refused return saves nothing. With it, Damage reported follows Tool returned and the tool needs repair with the return note, or "Returned needing repair." when there is none; a good return invokes nothing. When the handler fails, the return stands, the failure is reported and Tool returned stays undelivered; the next relay run delivers it and the tool needs repair.
